title: BATWA v2.4.47 Instant QR Scanner & Seamless P2P Payments
message: Instant real-world QR camera detection, direct P2P transfer recipient fetching, minimalist clean scanner UI, and compact receive QR cards.
features: Lightning QR Detection: Ultra-fast camera engine scans codes from screens and paper without missed frames.
Instant Recipient Fetching: Automatically resolves Batwa tags (@tag) and phone accounts directly into Send Money.
Minimalist Scan UI: Clean viewfinder frame with flashlight toggle, zero clutter buttons.
Compact Receive QR: Streamlined personal ID QR card designed for effortless scanning.
changelog: Cleaned scanner top bar: kept flashlight, removed flip camera, keyboard, and My QR button.
Cleaned scanner bottom area: removed Show My QR, Paste Code, and Test Scan buttons.
Made receive QR code compact and removed Dynamic Amount Request, Copy QR, and Pay buttons.
Directly connected scanner into SendMoney flow with auto-fetched recipient details.
